channel.title: [REDACTED] The Musical!
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "[REDACTED] The Musical!" - a tuning fork that makes people break into song and dance.

item.title: Re: [REDACTED] The Musical!
item.content:encoded:
Central Narrative: none

This is generally a deal breaker for me as a reviewer: a SCP like this is best shown by having people interact with it and like, really showing how the performances play out and really like, getting invested in them, y'know?

Beyond this, I don't really have a feel for what the article is gonna be like: the implication here is that stylistically it'll be like SCP-1797-J in structure but it feels to me that you'd need to do something more than just, have nods to various popular musical songs with a SCP twist to them for it to work to me? Like, you ask if you'd need to include lyrics and it feels to me that really this wants just, a short list of sample songs followed by maybe some kinda experiment log where a d-class uses it and starts singing and someone reacts say or something like that.

item.title: Forum Crit Staff - Operational Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
ThatKidRaz, this feedback is not particulaly helpful.

You talk about how to make an article more interesting, but there's nothing here that actually touches upon the concept specifically. if you don't plan on making a more comprehensive review, please hold off on making the first reply, as reviewers prioritize posts without reviews.

Author, please refer to the Butterfly Squad Roster to seek out another reviewer.

item.title: Re: [REDACTED] The Musical!
item.content:encoded: This could probably pass as a normal SCP. Love the concept, but I think it would benefit from some sort of negative twist. The article would sound kind of boring without something more serious to pull the viewers back into reality.

item.title: [REDACTED] The Musical!
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Comedy

Elevator Pitch: whenever the SCP is used, anyone that hears the tuning will immediately break into a song and dance number akin to that of a Broadway performance.

Central Narrative: none

Hook/Attention-Grabber: this SCP causes anyone who hears it to break into song and dance, and anyone who hears someone singing while under this affect will become part of the performance. While under this effect subjects with terrible singing voices will suddenly gain perfect pitch, people who can't dance or are out of shape will suddenly be able to perform movements and gymnastic techniques that would require years of training and months of intense choreography to perform, subjects with no instrument playing experience will suddenly be able to play musical instruments at an expert level. No one will realize this effect is happening until the performance is over.

Additional Notes:I'm not sure if this SCP would be classified as a joke SCP or just a funny SCP. there's also going to be a list of songs created by this SCP which are mostly SCP parodies of famous musical songs, such as;

  • It's a D-Class life (It's a hard knock life from Annie)
  • Defying Human Rights (Defying Gravity from Wicked)
  • Send in the Keter (Send in the Clowns from A Little Night Music)
  • The Sound of Science (The Sound of Music)
  • Ya Got a Breach (Ya Got Trouble from The Music Man)
  • If I were an O5 (If I were a Rich Man from Fiddler on the Roof)

and I just want to make sure, would I also need to include lyrics for these songs, I'm pretty sure I would, but I just want to be sure.
